items.text:
You are a dev sub-agent. Build ONE runnable experiment driver and verify it offline. Do NOT launch the real long run (the parent will run it as a tracked background job). You may make at most one tiny real smoke call per model key. No aesthetic judgment. User-facing report text in Chinese.

ROOT = D:\musicclaude\unified_run_handoff_20260924\unified_run_handoff_20260924 (git; runs/ is gitignored → `git add -f`). Python: `python -X utf8 -I`, stdlib only, insert ROOT\tools into sys.path.

## Background (why this exists)
Six prior E7 driver revisions (runs/run137_e7_flash_diag, run139, run142_r4, run144_r5, run146_r6, run148_r7) never produced any content: they are gated on Muse review-receipt typed-binding checks and a global gpt2 hold ("COMPLETION_PENDING"). That gating is being abandoned. The hold has been released (runs/_call_slots/gpt2web/queue_hold.json archived; user reports gpt2 works). Build a new, simple driver `runs/run149_e7_diag/go.py` that actually produces the diagnostic article and the judge results.

Reuse (read-only, copy logic as needed): runs/run137_e7_flash_diag/go.py (split/history/parse/stats/blind compare/rotation, uses tools/experiment_calls.call), and runs/run134_e7_diag/go.py. Use the existing shared call layer (tools/experiment_calls.call or tools/runner.run_job — whichever run137 uses and is tested) so identity/caching/meta stay consistent. DROP: Muse pack/receipt validation, typed receipt checks, COMPLETION_PENDING gating, frozen-config-can't-override logic.

## Experiment (Op.60, diagnostic only, not production)
Inputs (record sha256): beads = runs/run130_thread_e6/beads_clean.md (23 beads, split like run130: `### ` headings; title line = optional locator item "[认]"; each "- " bullet under 【此刻】 = "[此刻]" item, keep tags like 【另一种理解】【先后】). History = run130 gpt56w chain cumulative inventory before each step (same organization run130/run137 use). Option `--history-source` kept for later (default run130 gpt56w).

Stages (resumable; cached by exact prompt sha + model key; retry a failed call up to 2 times; parse failures retried):
1. why: k=2..23 with prompts/versions/WHY_GATE_v4.txt (HISTORY up to k-1; BEADS = beads 1..k title+【此刻】). differs=true sentence → item "[因为前面]". Model `--gen-model` default gpt56w.
2. mech: each bead with prompts/tooling/MECH_v1.txt (ITEMS = numbered 【此刻】 items, MM = title line), same gen model. Audit each relation with prompts/tooling/MECH_AUDIT_v0.txt by luna_noweb AND gflash_web (Gemini 3.8 Flash); drop if either says manufactured or imported; keep the rest's `relation` as item "[更深]". Record both verdicts.
3. surface: sequential over beads with prompts/versions/E7_SURFACE_v0.txt. SCREEN = items currently on screen labelled S1,S2…; ITEMS = this bead's candidates numbered 1,2… JSON: action, keep (S-ids), show (new ids), expand, recap, why. New screen = kept + shown; non-kept old items are "retired". Two independent chooser chains: gpt56w and opus.
4. render: per chooser `surface__<chooser>__op60.md` (per bead: title, screen items with 新 marks, retired items, action, why) and `reading__<chooser>__op60.md` (only what the reader sees changing; "（屏幕不变）" when unchanged; no ids/model names/why). Script stats: counts of 更新/补充/保持/沉默, mean screen items, total on-screen chars, retired count, on-screen counts by item type, longest consecutive on-screen streak (with text).
5. compare: whole-piece 3-way blind with prompts/tooling/E7_COMPARE_v0.txt. Candidates: (a) reading__gpt56w__op60.md; (b) production runs/run124_render/surface__B__gpt56w__op60.md converted to the same "reader sees" format (screen lines only; strip run122 action/why/rule text/model names); (c) V2A+Gemini reconstructed anchor runs/run132_v2a_gemini_baseline/outputs/run132__op60__gpro_web__s3.md (note in report: reconstructed, not original; also run a second variant of the whole compare with c = run132__op60__gflash_web__s1.md). Strip all model/version identifiers. Judges (user rule 10-09: generators MAY judge themselves; report each judge separately and flag self-judgment): gpt56w, gpt6w, opus, luna_noweb, gflash_web. Each judge 3 calls per variant with 甲乙丙 cyclic rotation; seeds + mapping recorded. gpt56w/gpt6w go through the gpt2 adapter route (MUSIC_WEB_ROUTE=gpt2; single concurrency, slow 1–15 min per call) — set the env inside the driver or document it in the launch command. Additionally export `muse_judge_pack.json` (the exact 3 rotated prompts per variant + mapping) so the parent can run Muse as an extra judge via its own tool; do NOT gate completion on Muse.
6. report: report.md (stats table; per-judge rankings table with self-judge flag; mean rank / #first per candidate per variant; position consistency; paths to raw judge outputs; 5 examples of retired items), run_manifest.json (git commit, all template/input/output sha256, model keys, actual MUSIC_WEB_ROUTE), then DONE (or FAILED with reason). If one judge model's route fails, continue others and list it as missing — don't block DONE on one judge.
CLI: `--stage why|mech|surface|render|compare|report|all` (default all), `--gen-model`, `--mock`.

## Verify
`--mock` full pipeline in a temp dir (no real calls, real dir untouched) + a small unittest file tools/tests/test_run149_e7_diag.py for: item numbering/retire logic, reader-format conversion of run124, rotation/mapping, report aggregation. Run existing tests in tools/tests too and make sure nothing regresses. One tiny real smoke call each for gflash_web, luna_noweb, opus (skip gpt56w/gpt6w smoke; parent will see them in the real run).

Commit: `git add -f runs/run149_e7_diag/go.py runs/run149_e7_diag/README.md` + the test file; message "run149 E7 diag driver (Opus subagent): runnable, no receipt gating" + trailer line "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". Do not touch prompts/, tools/runner.py semantics, or other runs.

Reply ≤8 lines: status, mock result, tests count, smoke results, exact launch command (with env), estimated number of gpt2 calls, any blocker.

459	    if not ok:

334	def call(step, core, model, prompt, parse_fn, key, prompt_version, extra=None):
335	    """一次逻辑调用（同一模型最多 MAX_ATTEMPTS 次）。返回 rec。"""
336	    h = sha256s(prompt)
337	    key = ["run134", step] + list(key)
338	    st = store(step)
339	    hit = st.get(key, model, h)
340	    if hit is not None:
341	        bump(step, model, "cached")
342	        rec = dict(hit)
343	        rec["cached"] = True
344	        return rec
345	    rec = {"key": key, "core": core, "model": model, "prompt_sha256": h, "prompt_version": prompt_version,
346	           "prompt_template": TPL_PATHS.get(prompt_version, prompt_version), "attempts": [], "cached": False,
347	           "parsed": None, "output": None, "output_file": None, "parse_ok": False, "parse_error": None}
348	    timeout = TMO_GPT if model in WEB_GPT else TMO_OTHER
349	    n, secs = 0, 0.0
350	    for att in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
351	        jid = (core if att == 0 else "%s__retry%d" % (core, att)) + "__h" + h[:10]
352	        job = {"job_id": jid, "branch": step, "model_key": model, "prompt": prompt,
353	               "prompt_version": prompt_version, "prompt_template": rec["prompt_template"],
354	               "work_key": WORK_KEY, "work_name": WORK_NAME, "sample": 1,
355	               "extra": dict(extra or {}, attempt=att), "forbid_tools": list(FORBID), "max_attempts": 1}
356	        try:
357	            if model in WEB_GPT:
358	                with GPT_SEM:
359	                    meta = RUN_JOB(str(OUT_DIR), job, timeout=timeout)
360	            else:
361	                meta = RUN_JOB(str(OUT_DIR), job, timeout=timeout)
362	        except Exception as e:
363	            meta = {"job_id": jid, "status": "failed", "error": "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)}
364	        n += 1
365	        try:
366	            secs += float((meta or {}).get("seconds") or 0.0)
367	        except Exception:
368	            pass
369	        out = _read_output(meta)
370	        entry = {"job_id": jid, "status": (meta or {}).get("status"), "meta_error": (meta or {}).get("error"),
371	                 "output_chars": len(out), "output_file": (meta or {}).get("output_file")}
372	        if isinstance(meta, dict) and meta.get("status") == "ok":
373	            if any(p in out for p in FROZEN):
374	                parsed, err = None, "frozen/activation/incomplete marker in output"
375	            else:
376	                parsed, err = parse_fn(out)
377	        else:
378	            parsed, err = None, "run failed: %s" % ((meta or {}).get("error"))
379	        entry["parse_ok"] = parsed is not None
380	        entry["parse_error"] = err
381	        rec["attempts"].append(entry)
382	        print("[%s %s %s] att%d ok=%s %s" % (step, model, core, att, parsed is not None, err or ""), flush=True)
383	        if parsed is not None:
384	            rec.update({"parsed": parsed, "output": out, "parse_ok": True, "output_file": entry["output_file"]})
385	            break
386	    bump(step, model, "calls", n, secs)
387	    bump(step, model, "retries", max(0, n - 1))
388	    if not rec["parse_ok"]:
389	        rec["parse_error"] = rec["attempts"][-1]["parse_error"] if rec["attempts"] else "no attempts"
390	        bump(step, model, "failed")
391	    st.put(dict(rec))
392	    return rec

I need to trace where that blocking policy line came from—checking git log to see if it's stale from an earlier revision I shouldn't override.

Monkeypatching the policy check for Opus specifically feels like bypassing a deliberate guard, so I should check ACTIVE_HANDOFF for the latest guidance before deciding. Separately, timeout-triggered holds will stop subsequent calls per provider, which the driver should just handle by continuing with other judges and reporting gaps, and failed retry-unsafe attempts in experiment_calls shouldn't be retried on rerun.

Since experiment_calls marks runner failures as non-retryable (to avoid duplicate costly submissions), I'll need my own retry wrapper around run_job that generates fresh job_ids per attempt, retrying failures up to the brief's limit unless a hold is in effect, rather than relying on experiment_calls' built-in logic.

I'll cap attempts by looping through indices, skipping already-failed metas and resuming successful ones, stopping once three new submissions have been made. For the queue-hold case, since a held provider writes a failed meta, that still consumes a job id slot but my skip-failed logic should let later reruns proceed once the hold clears.

I should check how gpt2_adapter handles its own queue hold separately from the runner's hold file, since it seems to maintain its own hold state and timeout behavior for ambiguous submissions.

For audit failures specifically, I'm leaning toward conservatively dropping that relation and recording it in the report rather than failing the whole run, treating it like the "drop if manufactured/imported" rule applied when verification is uncertain.

I'll decide: mark the run FAILED only on an exception or if a why/mech/surface record ends up incomplete, since the parent can rerun to resume; missing judges or audit failures get logged but don't block DONE status.

I'm noting the adapter acts as a global singleton, so a HOLD on failure stops the whole gpt2 route unless the failure is ambiguous and marked retry_safe with no hold, like run133's case. Once queue_stop triggers, my driver stops retrying that call, and subsequent calls fail fast with "gpt2 queue held" until a human clears it.

For failures without retry_safe=False (empty response, model mismatch), the hold isn't set so I retry with a new job id up to twice, per the brief's "unknown/protected failures don't continue" rule—only queue_stop halts things entirely. I also need to check prompt sizes against MAX_PROMPT_CHARS, since comparing whole articles across runs like run124 and run137 could push gpt2 judge prompts over the limit and cause failures.

The opus route runs through the claude CLI with model and effort flags, while gflash_web falls into the else-branch using the opencode-based muse parser. For history filtering, run130's steps.json needs to filter by model==gpt56w and work==op60, consistent with run134's logic.

The opus chooser chain relies on outputs generated by gpt56w, which works fine. For concurrency, why/mech generation can run in parallel since gpt56w calls are serialized by the gpt2 slot regardless, and audits like luna_noweb and gflash_web should run after mech generation completes — better to pipeline audits per bead.

I'm thinking audits should run inline right after mech generation for each bead, inside parallel worker threads, so luna/gflash audit work overlaps with the serialized gpt56w calls — using pmap over beads with six workers, where gpt2 calls stay serialized via the semaphore but other-model audits in the worker thread overlap naturally. My overall throughput plan: why+mech in parallel, then both surface chains in parallel, then compare — noting the opus surface chain only depends on why/mech outputs, and I'm settling on a gpt2 call timeout of 1800 seconds, with the runner holding on timeout even for non-gpt providers like codex, gemini, or opus.

A timeout for any provider writes a hold file that blocks all subsequent calls for that provider — which seems harsh (e.g. one slow luna_noweb call could stall all codex calls), but that's just how the runner works, so I'll just note it. ### m.4至m.6

- 【听】第4到第6小节，左手开始一下一下地摇，右手的旋律还没进来。
- 前面还悬着，这两下摇晃一出来，脚下就像终于有了支撑。

### m.6至m.16–17之间

- 【听】从第6小节到第16—17小节之间，右手两条旋律贴着走，一起升、一起落，轻轻地唱得很长。左手一直在下面摇。

### m.16–17之间至m.24

- 【听】从第16—17小节之间到第24小节，刚才两条旋律贴着唱的那段又回来了。装饰音更多，越唱越高，换气也越来越急。

- 说了一遍，还想再补半句，让这份感觉多留一会儿。像聊天聊高兴了，怕话停下来，越说越快，身体也往前倾。

### m.24至m.35

- 【听】第24—35小节，旋律的花样越来越密，一次次往上够，又落回来。第32—34小节涨到最满，第35小节有个音悄悄降了半音，光线就变了。
- 越听越陷进去，心里也越不安。那份甜让人还想要更多，也勾起了烦躁。

### m.35至m.40

=====
要真正听懂肖邦的《升F大调船歌》（Op.60），我们需要先了解这首曲子诞生时一个极其强烈的**心理矛盾**：

这首曲子写于1845至1846年间。此时的肖邦正处于生命的黄昏，肺结核让他身体极度虚弱，他与爱人乔治·桑的关系也走向了令人心碎的破裂。然而，恰恰是一个连呼吸都感到费力、爱情正在死去的将死之人，写出了这首被法国作曲家拉威尔誉为“最壮丽”、被钢琴大师傅聪认为“充满火山般热情”的作品。

所以，这并不是一次真实的、惬意的威尼斯水上游览（肖邦终生未去过威尼斯），而是一场**“将死之人对生命和爱情最绝望也最狂热的回望”**。钢琴大师傅聪曾用晚唐诗人李商隐的诗境来比喻晚期的肖邦：表面唯美精致，内里却极其错综复杂，酸甜苦辣全揉在一起。

顺着音乐的进行，一个听众大致会经历以下几个心理阶段：

### 1. 梦境的开启与水面上的幻影（mm. 1-34）
*   **一声叹息的引子（mm. 1-3）：** 乐曲并没有直接开始摇荡。一开始是一个沉重、深邃的和弦，像是一声长叹，又像是缓缓拉开了一道沉重的记忆帷幕。它在问：“你准备好进入这个梦了吗？”
*   **双重唱与完美的幻象（mm. 4-34）：** 随后，左手开始了极具韧性、起伏不断的“摇橹”节奏，这就是水面。右手的旋律进来后，并不是单音，而是很多“双音”（三度或六度和弦）。在听觉上，这就像是**一对恋人在波光粼粼的水面上依偎着唱二重唱**。
    *   **此时的情绪不是纯粹的快乐，而是一种“带有忧愁的甜蜜”**。因为它的美太不真实了，就像黄昏时分水面上的反光，美得让人心醉，但你心里隐隐知道，太阳马上就要落山了。这种情绪是一种极度的**眷恋与怀旧**。

### 2. 向内探索：耳语、脆弱与不安（mm. 35-61）
*   **光线暗淡（m. 35起）：** 突然，水面的摇荡变得缓慢了，刚才明亮耀眼的色彩暗了下来（转入A大调区域）。那对恋人的歌声不再向外舒展，而是变成了极度私密的耳语。
*   **孤独与脆弱感：** 这里的旋律变得有些支离破碎，充满试探。对于听者来说，原本完美的幻觉在这里出现了裂痕。你会感到一种深深的**孤独感和心碎感**——也许是船上的人想起了现实，也许是回忆者意识到逝去的爱人再也无法触及。这是一种“想要抓住什么，却感到它正在从指缝中溜走”的无力。

### 3. 现实的入侵与精神的挣扎（mm. 62-83）
*   **风浪骤起：** 平静被彻底打破。这不仅是水面上的风浪，更是内心的惊涛骇浪。音乐变得非常焦躁、动荡，充满着极强的身体冲撞感和和声的不断游移。
*   **求生欲与抗争（m. 78起）：** 情绪从忧伤转为了一种**近乎痛苦的挣扎与狂热**。这非常像肖邦那具破败的躯体在做最后的挣扎，他不甘心被疾病和失恋吞噬。音乐不断向上攀爬，呼吸变得越来越急促（Poco più mosso），情绪被推向一个让人窒息的顶点，仿佛一个人在悬崖边上仰天长呼，呼唤生命的奇迹。
